blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Basilan Gov. Mujiv Hataman has debunked social and mainstream media reports that a total lockdown was imposed in the province following the two recent ambush incidents targeting Army soldiers. He clarified that daily life and movement across the province remain completely normal. “A friend in the media (not the Inquirer) seems to have made a mistake in their report stating that there is a total lockdown here in Basilan—that is not true,” he said in Filipino in a video statement posted on his official social media page late Monday afternoon.
